text:
maya: evening handoff — ongoing pager for embeddings us-west. seeing ~10% of /v1/embeddings return 503s and some p95 latency spikes. primary @alex, secondary @kevin. brief timeline below.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #2481 — embeddings-usw-503 (pager triggered at 2026-03-17T18:12:01Z). Pager severity: Sev2. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-503

alex: on it. noticed node-7 OOMs in embedding-worker. started cordon/drain, scaling embedding-pool +2.

kevin: ran `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embedding-pool` — several CrashLoopBackOffs. restarting deployment now.
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedding-pool -n inference
kubectl scale deploy embedding-pool --replicas=12 -n inference
```

alex: rolling restart complete on worker pool, added instance with 32GB. KV cache pressure dropped. traffic rerouted away from node-7. Logs: `OOMKilled` at 18:10:54 UTC.

joanna: any customer-facing impact? are any Dedicated customers in the fail path?

alex: quick impact assessment: ~3% of hosted API calls failed intermittently last 40m; we rerouted most production traffic via us-east and eu-west. No Dedicated contracts affected (they're on dedicated-only clusters), but one self-serve customer (org: greenleaf) reported failed embeddings. Support notified and seeding rollback tokens; CS already opened ticket.

kevin: temporary mitigations applied: 1) scaled pool, 2) cordoned bad node, 3) enabled prefix caching on embedding route to reduce load. Monitoring: p50/p95 improving. Will keep autoscaler paused for 10m to avoid flip.

maya: runbook checklist completed (cordon/drain, scale, reroute, notify CS). links:
- runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/embeddings-503
- playbook snippet: https://confluence.redwood/ops/embeddings-fallback

joanna: re: customer comms — Support sent note to greenleaf, CS assigned @lina to own follow-up. ETA for full stable: ~30m, but will update if we see regressions.

alex: followups for next shift: 1) investigate why node-7 got OOM (query pattern + model mem profile), 2) validate autoscaler thresholds, 3) confirm no regression after scaling down.

maya: ok handoff: primary for next shift is kevin, secondary is alex. last_message: 1735556123. I'll ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
